Today we’re meeting up with a man living full-time out of a fire truck and hitting the open road through one of the most fascinating stretches of the country. From Sedona to an old company town, a Native reservation, a mountain ghost town, and Arizona’s former territorial capital—this one’s all about discovery, contrast, and good times.
